verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's Wally CLI documents an integrations feature where one command points a tool at a model and starts it with nothing to configure by hand. opencode is named as a launched tool that defaults to an on-machine model unless `--cloud` is passed, and the same CLI runs local models offline without an account. missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported third-party coding agents beyond opencode, detailed per-agent setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration of the launch flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command

citations.quote: One command points a tool at a model and starts it. There is nothing to configure by hand
`--cloud` is an `opencode` flag: it asks for the hosted model rather than one on this machine.
When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
